reload_pth_emb: reload pretrained word embeddings from a PyTorch binary file given a path and embedding dimension
reload_txt_emb: reload pretrained word embeddings from a GloVe-style text file given a path and embedding dimension
reload_embeddings: reload pretrained embeddings from either a PyTorch binary or text file based on file extension
initialize_embeddings: initialize encoder and decoder embeddings with pretrained vectors for each language in a multilingual NMT model
test_reload_embeddings: test the reload_embeddings function to verify it correctly loads embeddings from both pth and txt formats
